product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Workstation Wall Mount for Keyboard and Monitor
product.description: This computer wall mount is a good solution for setting up workstations in tight, busy, or nontraditional work spaces.This is ideal for computer workstations that support non‑computer based work, like in shops, labs, warehouses, garages, production floors, stores, and other applications. The mount securely attaches computer workstations to a wall and takes little space. Computers are kept off the floor and out of the way to fit busy work environments.This monitor mount fits standard 75x75 and 100x100 VESA® compatible monitors, and is designed to support up to 55 pound loads. The keyboard tray is adjustable for height, offset, and angle, so it can fit multiple users. There is ample space for a full keyboard and mouse setup, so users can stay productive with familiar computer peripherals.Made of quality steel parts, this mount keeps computers safe and secure. Hardware to mount securely to concrete walls or wood studs is included, or use with appropriate hardware (not included) for other mounting applications.Features: Monitor mount supports up to 55 lbs.Recommended for up to 32" screensMonitor mount is compatible with 75x75 and 100x100 VESA® monitorsKeyboard tray supports up to 4.4 lbs., with ample room for a full keyboard and mouseA fitted mouse pad is includedPair with PID 34544 for a fully wall‑mounted computer setupSupport Files: User's Manual (Jul 16, 2018)Dimensions Diagram (Sep 6, 2018)Monoprice™, WORKSTREAM™, the WORKSTREAM logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. VESA® is a registered trademark of the Video Electronics Standards Association.
